gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-oxygen: Bold, low-slung letters with no hairlines to go faint at small sizes. Oxygen backs it up with curves left open and lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, sturdy in its own quieter way.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-saira: Grandstander bends bold, wire-like s curves that never thin at the spine, with short ascenders under a tall x-height. Saira does the quieter job, rounding letters that stretch toward the top line and leaving each s visibly open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans: Gugi stands out through lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals and terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Sofia Sans then takes over with rounded stencil-like letters of uniform stroke width, a steady counterweight on the page.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arimo: Metamorphous carries wide sidebearings, a high-set midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes that never turns stark. Arimo then adds spacious gaps in its rounded letters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-chivo: Soft stroke contrast and generous sidebearings give Metamorphous its commanding look. Chivo packs its lowercase close to the capitals and lets daylight through every curve, a friendly counter to the display.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fresca: Commanding, high-waisted letters with soft stroke shifts. Fresca keeps its sans-serif lines free of calligraphic thinning, with open apertures and short ascenders over big bowls, so it steadies the heading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-heebo: A high-set midline gives Metamorphous its commanding look. Heebo has a tall central band and curves that stop short of closing, so it holds up well at a modest size.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hind-guntur: Metamorphous spaces itself wide, with a high-set midline. Hind Guntur is built like a steel cable outline with tall, stamped-metal lowercase, so a medium size lets those wide gaps breathe.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hind-siliguri: Soft, commanding stress in its round letters. Metamorphous is best at that gentle contrast and wide sidebearings, while Hind Siliguri hums along in flat, constant line weight with rounds that gap open.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern, with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars matching the stems they join. Metamorphous does the commanding work up top, with thin strokes close to thick.
